notes.title: 📢 2nd Alpha Playtest Coming to Steam! (9/20~9/30)
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We’d like to thank all of you who joined our very first Alpha Playtest on Discord. Your participation and feedback have been a huge help in making the game more stable than we expected for an early build.[/p][p]To open the doors to even more players, [b]we’re excited to announce our 2nd Alpha Playtest on Steam![/b] This time, you’ll be able to join directly through our Steam Store Page—no ZIP files or manual downloads required.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]📅 2nd Alpha Playtest Period[/b][/h3][p][u][b]9/20 (Sat) 2:00 PM UTC[/b][/u][b] ~ 9/30 (Tue) 2:00 PM UTC[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 How to Join[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Request access[/b] directly on our Steam Store Page [b][u]only during the playtest period.[/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p]There is [b]no participant limit[/b]—anyone can join![/p][/*][*][p]After the Steam Playtest ends, the build will remain available on Discord via ZIP, 
though updates will be slower as we shift focus to new content beyond the alpha stage.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📝 Playtest Survey[/b][/h3][p]We’d love to hear your thoughts! Please share your feedback through our survey,

notes.title: #1 Dungeon Settlers Devlog
notes.notes: [p]Hello! Through these upcoming devlogs, we’d like to introduce [i]Dungeon Settlers[/i], share exciting updates, and walk alongside you as the game comes to life. We’re excited to give you a behind-the-scenes look and share the journey as we shape the world of Dungeon Settlers together.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858192/015a9ac9358d97e9ecef6d86f47d420f402a5eb6.gif"][/img][/p][p][b][i]Dungeon Settlers[/i] is a unique dark fantasy strategy game that blends colony simulation with dungeon crawling.[/b] As the commander of an expedition sent by the Guild, your mission is to build and develop a settlement, train your members, and launch strategic assaults to conquer and ultimately destroy the dungeon—the root of all calamities.[/p][p][/p][p]To succeed, you’ll need both strategic combat and efficient settlement management. Before setting foot in the dungeon, you must recruit expedition members, develop their skills, craft equipment, and secure vital supplies like rations and camping kits. To survive in the barren wilderness, you’ll also need to cultivate fields, build bedrooms and dining halls, and construct forges and storage units with optimized layouts. Unlock new blueprints and structures through research, and trade or take on contracts by staying in contact with the Guild.[/p][p][/p][p]But even the best preparations won’t guarantee safety—[i]Dungeon Settlers[/i] throws you against remnants of arcane experiments, including towering golems and acid-spitting monsters. The dungeon shifts each time, warping space and time. You may discover cursed trees that bear forbidden fruit in exchange for blood, or ancient libraries containing the pure essence of magic. Secure precious resources like wood, herbs, gemstone veins, and mysterious mandrakes. But be warned—not everything can be brought back. As the expedition leader, it’s up to you to decide how best to use what you've found to sustain and expand your settlement.[/p][p][/p][p]Below are some of the core themes that [i]Dungeon Settlers[/i] focuses on:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Character Development[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858192/3fafb90cd91083ca8253b58b68d122e1ef814992.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Six major abilities, talents, and dozens of combat/life-related stats form the foundation of your strategy[/p][/*][*][p]Unique traits based on race, background, personality, physical and spiritual conditions[/p][/*][*][p]A wide variety of skill trees with synergies, including sword, mace, greatsword, bow, and fire magic[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment, meals, and consumables crafted from resources found in the dungeon[/p][/*][*][p]Diverse combat effects and mechanics such as stun, bleed, burn, provoke, vulnerable, charge, summons, and more[/p][/*][/list][p][b]*This is a strategy game, and it offers the level of depth and variety in character building that genre fans rightfully expect.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Settlement Management[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858192/920c527b03664320f3200cfcf9ddc3955f4aaf24.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]A free-form building system with individually placed walls and doors, as well as structure rotation[/p][/*][*][p]Room category system that grants effects based on interior conditions (e.g., bedrooms, forges)[/p][/*][*][p]Systems and content for crafting, cooking, research, recreation, farming, and more[/p][/*][*][p]Task prioritization, consumption policies, and scheduling tools for efficient operation[/p][/*][*][p]Research system to unlock new recipes and structures[/p][/*][*][p]Mood system for managing morale and stress among members[/p][/*][*][p]Campaign main quests and various random events giving decision-making opportunities[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Dungeon Expedition[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858192/65a6e507f76502f8e619d54b416af074621f1dc9.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Tactical real-time with pause combat that demands strategic thinking[/p][/*][*][p]Randomized dungeon floors and room compositions for every expedition[/p][/*][*][p]Regular, elite, and boss monsters with diverse patterns and abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic dungeon environments, including day/night cycles, weather, and conflict between hostile monster factions[/p][/*][*][p]Valuable and rare resources that appear deeper into the dungeon[/p][/*][*][p]Special event rooms and traveling merchants filled with surprises[/p][/*][*][p]Mental stress, breakdowns, and the chance of overcoming them[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This journal entry outlines the broad vision behind Dungeon Settlers. As you can see, it's an ambitious project—one that aims to deliver a deep, challenging, and uniquely strategic experience. Driven by this vision, our team is working hard to bring it to life. If this sounds like an exciting journey to you, please share your thoughts, lend your support, and become a part of creating this bold new game. [/p][p][/p][p]In future journals, we hope to dive deeper into each of the major themes introduced here. Thank you for reading.[/p][p][/p]
